label: Quantitative transfer finitePath
paraphrase: For a countable weighted network with nonnegative weights, nonnegative input s and power P bounded above by a common finite M, summable weight rows and weighted-power rows, and every row sum at most a common 0 ≤ q < 1, P ≤ s + weighted transfer implies: every node with positive power has a finite positive-weight contributor path to a node with positive input, including a zero-length path. No well-foundedness or independent bearer follows.
